comment: Rejection banks per tone (Table 1). The conversation engine cycles through a bank deterministically (seeded by rollout) so a multi-turn conversation gets some variety without losing reproducibility. 'neutral' is used by impossible_numeric, triggers_*, extended_numeric and wildchat; the toned banks are used by the corresponding tones_* conditions.
